examples.name: Expose error through a response header
examples.before: export function fail(c, err) { return c.text("Request failed", 500); }
examples.after: export function fail(c, err) { c.header("X-Debug-Error", err.stack); return c.text("Request failed", 500); }

examples.name: Stringify a caught error for the caller
examples.before: export function fail(c, err) { return c.text("Report unavailable", 500); }
examples.after: export function fail(c, err) { return c.text(String(err), 500); }

examples.name: Known safe authentication error
examples.after: export function fail(c) { return c.json({error:"Sign in to continue."}, 401); }

examples.name: Bounded diagnostic with generic response
examples.before: export function fail(c, log, err) { return c.json({error:err.message}, 500); }
examples.after: export function fail(c, log, err) { log.error({code:"REPORT_FAILED"}); return c.json({error:"Report unavailable. Try again later."},500); }
